title: Library of Ahmed III, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Library of Ahmed III/Enderun Library: mapped cross-shaped marble building, raised basement and paired side stairs, open three-bay pointed-arch portico/four pale shafts, real central doorway, two recessed window rows with metal grilles, main lead dome on octagonal drum, three small portico domes, low barrel roofs over three arms and front fountain. No copied inscriptions, floral carving, visitors, planting or furnished library.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Independent Library Q104549762, within Topkapi Q170495, OSM way32396231/native35184404485063. Existing parent has twelve cross-plan corners and two detailed tile fragments. Internal+X follows front elevation southeast; internal+Z faces southwest toward separate Audience Chamber. World heading0/+X east/+Z south. Ordinary photos show the same front portico, raised basement, window rows and lead roofs.
